recipe.title: Home-Style Kadhi Pakora

steps.text: Whisk together curd, besan, sliced onions, garlic, ginger, turmeric, chilly powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt and water to make the kadi mixture.
steps.label: Mix kadi

steps.text: Heat a pan and add oil. When the oil heats up add methi dana, cumin and dry red chilly; stir and add heeng, give a quick stir.
steps.label: Temper spices

steps.text: Add the kadi mixture to the pan, stir continuously till it comes to a boil. Now lower the heat and let it cook for half hour; keep stirring in between so that it does not stick to the bottom.
steps.label: Cook kadi
steps.attention_cue: keep stirring in between so that it does not stick to the bottom.
steps.doneness_cue: nicely thickened, rawness of the flour has completely disappeared

steps.text: Mix together besan, salt, chopped green chilly, turmeric, red chilly powder, coriander seeds, cumin, baking powder, chopped spinach and water to make a thick pakora batter.
steps.label: Make pakora batter

steps.text: Heat oil in a deep pan and drop small dollops of the batter to make pakoras; fry them on mild flame patiently so they cook through (first fry until partially cooked).
steps.label: Fry pakoras (first)

steps.text: Give the partially fried pakoras a little rest so the heat penetrates to the insides.
steps.label: Rest pakoras
steps.attention_cue: Give it a little rest, So that the heat penetrates to the insides.

steps.text: Heat the oil hotter and fry the rested pakoras again until evenly cooked and light brown on the outside (finish fry).
steps.label: Finish fry

steps.text: Check the cooked kadi for salt and transfer it to a serving bowl.
steps.label: Finish kadi

steps.text: Ten minutes before serving, add the fried pakoras to the piping hot kadi.
steps.label: Add pakoras

steps.text: In a clean pan heat desi ghee, add coriander and cumin seeds; once they crackle, turn off the heat, add red chilly powder, stir and immediately pour this tempering over the kadi pakora.
steps.label: Make tempering

Kadhi pakora recipe | Punjabi kadhi recipe | recipe for kadhi pakora. perhaps one of the popular north Indian curry recipe made with chickpea flour, sour yogurt, and spices. it is typically served as a side dish to the choice of rice recipes, but can also be served with roti and chapati. It's the weekend then you know it is Kadi Chawal time. Punjabi style Kadi Pakora made just the way my mother makes it at home, esp on Sunday.

Ingredients:
FOR KADI
1 ½cups Curd
4 tbsp Besan (gram flour)
½cup Onion sliced
½tbsp Garlic chopped
½tbsp Ginger chopped
3/4 tsp Turmeric
1tsp Red chilly powder
1 tbsp Coriander powder
1 tsp Roasted Cumin Powder
to taste Salt
10 cups Water
3 tbsp Oil
1 tsp Methi dana (fenugreek)
1 tsp Cumin
2 nos Dry red chilly
½tsp Heeng (asafoetida)

FOR PAKORA
1cup Besan (gram flour)
to taste Salt
1no Green chilly chopped
½tsp Turmeric
1 tsp Red chilly powder
1 tbsp Coriander seeds
 tsp Cumin
3/4 tsp Baking Powder
1 cup Spinach chopped
3/4 cup Water

FOR TEMPERING
2 tbsp Desi Ghee
2 tsp Coriander seeds
1 tsp Cumin
½tsp Red chilly powder
